correction.original_formula: theta_candidate=theta_center+sign*radius*sqrt(C_pp)*e_p, with every other parameter held at its center
correction.direction_formula: For period p, theta_candidate=theta_center+sign*radius*(C*e_p)/sqrt(C_pp); all parameters may move because C*e_p generally has nonzero off-diagonal components
correction.derivation: For direction g=e_p, the ellipsoid support identity gives maximizing displacement delta=radius*C*g/sqrt(g^T*C*g). Then delta^T*C^(-1)*delta=radius^2. The original coordinate-only displacement is valid only when the covariance direction has no off-diagonal components
correction.observed_failure_before_correction: On the first frozen fold, coordinate-only b4 and b7 perturbations produced quadratic forms 135.77471580480335 and 142.43605405017527 instead of 16, so all 136 first-fold candidate evaluations were correctly rejected as infeasible and no result file was written
correction.unchanged_structure: The four direction labels, five folds, 168 months, 20 direction records and 672 evaluations remain unchanged. The Schur-complement slice rule, baseline and numerical certification rules are unchanged
correction.effective_rule: Only the candidate displacement formula is superseded. Candidate names b4_minus, b4_plus, b7_minus and b7_plus now denote the full covariance-support directions, not coordinate-only perturbations
